parsed.post: New personal best! 0.841334 -> 0.839107. Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 seems to be helping the depth-6 model generalize. Now that we have a strong regularized base, I'll probe the learning rate further to find the optimal balance between capacity and stability. Let's see if LR 0.03 works better.
parsed.description: Decreasing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 to continue the trend of lower learning rates improving stability and performance with the 262k batch size.
